items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Here are two dates with a great piano player that nobody knows about, named Aydin Esen. ... Genius.

ctx.x: Yep. Very disorganized date, because Aydin is kind of loose. He’s like a mad genius running around the room.
Let’s see. Moving along. This one looks really weird. This is definitely a Japanese record, Sax Legends.
